exposure: True knot of the umbilical cord (TKUC)
cohort: The study included 283,055 women with singleton pregnancies who delivered between 24 and 42 weeks of gestation from 2005 to 2021 at two large obstetrical centers.
finding: True knot of the umbilical cord (TKUC) is associated with an increased risk of intrauterine fetal death (IUFD), particularly in the late third trimester, and various adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with TKUC experienced higher rates of vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery, while the rate of intrapartum cesarean deliveries was similar between groups.
